requirement_summary: Beacon Protection Enabled is described as one setting for all affiliated APs of an AP MLD (no 'shall').
notes: Supports the rule; the 'shall' is §12.12.9. The model has one MLD-wide beacon_protection setting (ApConfig).

requirement_summary: Affiliated APs of an AP MLD advertise the same RSNE/RSNXE except the AKM list and MFPR, and share at least one AKM.
notes: Audit (#64, 2026-11-13): the RSNXE half isn't checked by SEC.MLD_COMMON_SUITES; per-link AKM lists that differ in SAE presence may give different RSNXEs in hostapd (follow-up experiment).

requirement_summary: For MLO the client sends one RSNE whose AKM, pairwise and group cipher are common to all affiliated APs; a client with no overlap declines.
The AP MLD compares MFPC/MFPR per requested link to decide which links it accepts.
notes: P0 has one PMF setting for the whole AP MLD, so per-link MFPC/MFPR differences can't be expressed. Strength not recorded in the research; check the PDF if this becomes a rule.

requirement_summary: RSNA rekeying for MLO: the AP MLD manages the PTKSA, each affiliated AP its own group keys; a new PTKSA should be set up before the old one expires.
notes: Only a 'should' (recommendation), which the strength vocabulary has no value for; recorded as the caveat on the rekey interval dimensions (runs/smoke/README.md), not a rule.

requirement_summary: Other RSNA subclauses for MLO next to §12.6.2-§12.6.3.2 and §12.6.19, not yet read for rules on the modeled settings.
notes: Read in the PDF; add a row per requirement found.

requirement_summary: EHT APs and EHT non-AP STAs using RSN have beacon protection enabled.
notes: Client side enforced through the _client_bp wrappers.

requirement_summary: Two EHT STAs negotiating SAE use AKM 00-0F-AC:24 or :25.
notes: 1793690818 (plain SAE) is the labeled negative experiment; 1793897820 passes.

requirement_summary: In SAE between two EHT STAs both advertise and use hash-to-element.
A NOTE says an EHT AP using RSN has PMF activated, following from the clause's rules.
notes: A NOTE is never a rule on its own; SEC.PMF's 'shall' is 802.11-2024 §11.52.

requirement_summary: A NOTE repeating that AP MLD links advertise the same RSNE apart from the AKM list and MFPR.
notes: Informative restatement of §12.6.2, which SEC.MLD_COMMON_SUITES cites.

requirement_summary: ML security: one PTKSA across the setup links, and a GTKSA/IGTKSA/BIGTKSA per link; different links use different group keys.
notes: Candidate behavior check (per-link group keys); not modeled. Strength to check in the PDF.

requirement_summary: Removing affiliated APs: announcement and removal timer; a non-AP MLD whose only setup link is removed is disassociated.
notes: The clause says nothing about associating afterwards (UND.ASSOC_WITHOUT_AP_LINKS).

requirement_summary: Neighbouring subclauses of §35.3.6, not yet read for rules on link_remove and link reconfiguration.
notes: Read in the PDF; setup_link_reconfig isn't run here yet.

requirement_summary: Link disablement: no individually addressed frames on a disabled link; a non-AP MLD whose setup links are all disabled is disassociated, and an unassociated STA doesn't send (Re)association Requests on a disabled link.
notes: hostap's mld_indicate_disabled is static, not the TTLM procedure; only the observed behavior is claimed.

requirement_summary: Other link-management subclauses of §35.3.7 (around §35.3.7.5), not yet read for rules on the modeled actions.
notes: Read in the PDF.

requirement_summary: Beacon protection for MLDs; Table 9-192 points here (per SEC.EHT_BEACON_PROT's source note, no 'shall' either).
notes: No 'shall' recorded; SEC.EHT_BEACON_PROT rests on §12.12.9. Page not recorded.

requirement_summary: Beacon protection is off whenever PMF isn't activated.
notes: Not coded as a P1 check: P0 can't express PMF disabled, so it's rejected as malformed.

requirement_summary: A NOTE says the receiver ignores the SAE hash-to-element bit when SAE isn't negotiated.
notes: Supports a dependency rule, not a spec rule.

requirement_summary: Hash-to-element is one of SAE's two ways to derive the password element (ECC and FFC groups).
BSS membership selector 123, SAE Hash to Element Only: joining a BSS that advertises it requires SAE hash-to-element support.
notes: Supports a dependency rule (issue #88), not a spec rule. Checked in the PDF by Michelle, 2026-11-13 (PR #92).

requirement_summary: STAs use the Supported Rates and BSS Membership Selectors elements to avoid joining a BSS whose membership selectors they don't support.
notes: Descriptive; the clause's 'shall's are about including selectors. Checked in the PDF by Michelle, 2026-11-13 (PR #92).

notes: We don't have the WPA3 Specification.

requirement_summary: With an AP MLD the client picks an AKM and pairwise cipher enabled on every affiliated link, or doesn't associate.
notes: Not yet read for which ciphers it lists for EHT (ap_pairwise_cipher, issue #61).

requirement_summary: The SAE hash-to-element setting applies only with an SAE AKM, for AP and STA. An AP set to H2E Only advertises the H2E-only selector; a STA with H2E Disabled doesn't connect to it.
AP MLD links share RSNE/RSNXE except the AKM list and MFPR; AKMs on only some links serve non-ML associations.
EHT or MLO associations that use a password need WPA3 enabled.
notes: Candidate guidance rule: a password-only EHT/MLO candidate without an SAE AKM (e.g. WPA-PSK alone) isn't WPA3.

requirement_summary: For EHT APs and STAs, beacon protection Enabled is MAND and Disabled DISALLOW in every mode.
